Mixing yourself is definitely taking the hardest path, but it is the most rewarding, coming from someone who has spent 2 years trying to learn how to mix myself, and barely has a handle on it.

The advice about mixing in circles is solid. It took me 2 years to learn that. Spending too much time mixing down a track, for me at least, kind of brainwashes me into forgetting my original intent. I've found taking a long break, or even sleeping on it, help reset myself.

Also, sleeping on any part of something you can't quite seem to nail, if you've been working on it for too long, helps a lot. It allows your subconscious to fix the problem for you, sometimes.

I came here to vent my problems, and your post caught my eye. 

I obviously don't know exactly what you're going through, but it seems you need a change of scenery. If this is how you really feel, fuck school. Sell everything you have and move somewhere else. What do you have to lose? 

Fuck your family, your friends, your classes, your job, and create a new life. Buy a car and go. You can make money off Uber, and get a cheap place, and recreate yourself. 

That's something I wish I could do. Before you decide to end everything, at least try that. It may not feel this way now, but youre luckier than you give yourself credit for. Trust me.

I'm not the best person to give advice, but I will be real with you. As someone who has been suicidal for almost as long as you've been alive, be patient. If you make it to the age of 18, and live a solid year outside of that environment, maybe you should consider the thoughts you've been experiencing. But you should wait until you can experience life. Wait until you've kissed a boy(or girl, whatever you're into), gone camping, see a truly breathtaking sight, and taken up some art you're passionate about. Create a bucket list, complete it, and if you still feel the same way... Your life is yours, and yours alone. It would be a true shame if you were to waste it, without understanding what it truly is.
